payload.text: A parallel-plate capacitor has plate area A, separation d, and dielectric ε; it is charged from 0 to Q.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Predict how the observable changes when the defining scale parameter is doubled, and justify the prediction quantitatively.

criteria.description: Since U=Q²/(2C) with C held fixed, U scales as the square of Q; doubling Q quadruples the stored energy to 4Q²/(2C)=2Q²/C.
accepted_variants: Equivalent scientifically correct notation and reasoning earn credit.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show U=Q²/(2C); energy quadruples; quadratic in Q.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Identify the governing principle (U=Q²/(2C)) and the assumption that C remains fixed at εA/d, and explain how each justifies the predicted scaling when Q is doubled.

criteria.description: Identify the governing principle (U=Q²/(2C)) and the assumption that C remains fixed at εA/d, and explain how each justifies the predicted scaling when Q is doubled.
accepted_variants: Equivalent scientifically correct notation and reasoning earn credit.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show U=Q²/(2C); constant C=εA/d.

accessibility.accommodation_notes: Text and symbolic notation are fully described.

known_boundary_cases: Award credit only when the conclusion follows from explicit evidence.
Check units, sign, and stated approximation.
